handoff_instructions: M2-T15 (SMS adapter (Twilio)) done in one step. Added packages/integrations/src/adapters/twilio-sms-provider.ts: TwilioSmsProvider implements SmsProvider using the global fetch (no vendor SDK) against the Twilio REST Messages endpoint with Basic auth; sendSMS caches results by (organizationId, idempotencyKey) so retries don't double-send, maps Twilio message statuses to the domain's queued/sent/delivered/failed, and throws on non-2xx responses; verifyWebhookSignature implements Twilio's real HMAC-SHA1(authToken, webhookUrl + sorted param pairs) base64 scheme with a fail-closed, constant-time comparison; ingestWebhook normalizes MessageSid/SmsSid into ProviderSmsWebhookEvent. Exported the adapter from packages/integrations/src/index.ts (1-line addition). Added packages/integrations/test/twilio-sms-provider.test.ts (22 assertions total across the package) covering: correct request shape/auth/body, status mapping, idempotent send (no second fetch call), cross-org idempotency-key distinction, non-2xx error handling, valid/tampered/missing-header signature verification, and webhook ingestion incl. missing-identifier error. No DB/tables touched (adapter-only, no RLS needed) and no authorization logic added here (kept out of the adapter per rule 4; auth stays in domain services). Nothing outside packages/integrations changed - apps/web/src/server/providers.ts still wires FakeSmsProvider and was intentionally left alone since wiring the real adapter into app code is not part of this task's scope. pnpm lint/typecheck/test all pass at the repo root. Next: M2-T16 "Voice adapter (Vapi)" - mirror this same pattern (adapter class + mocked-fetch tests) for VoiceProvider.
